scope: Additive implementation-coverage patch for one existing reading. This is not a replacement review collection.
implementation_scope_note: Selected original velociraptor1.20.0 Linux/WSL trusted-R-script workflow with original R preprocessing, all7 S4 signatures, SingleCellExperiment/AnnData conversion and declared scvelo0.3.3 backend. Exact tested profile: R4.5.3,Python3.12.10,NumPy2.2.6,Pandas2.2.3,SciPy1.16.3; not a recovered author environment. Separate R-only figures use complete supplied fits/projections without a Python fitting backend.13 complete numeric original comparisons,4 complete original figure pairs/8 graph replays,2 matching original errors,36 controls and6 complete examples validate selected integration paths, not the entire package, paper results, biological interpretation or convergence. Unknown author editions, mode, calls and the Velocyto-name/velociraptor-URL discrepancy remain unchanged. The native Java grid component calculates neither RNA velocity nor latent time and adds no second family credit. Original native R stack diagnostics remain unresolved; review complete raw consoles and conditions and keep unknown totals unavailable. SKIP3 skips dependent analysis for missing/forbidden prerequisites or execution. FAIL2 admits no complete result, including recording failures. Preserve original/partial objects, literal identifiers and NA/NaN/Inf; correct the named cause and retry NEW paths without changing saved hashes. Four historical direct-Python scVelo SVGs remain irrecoverable.
